rationale: #841 round 16 turned this fixture from a recovery-shape pin into a correct-contract pin. Penalising the grammar's TYPELESS field branch (prec.dynamic(-1)) removed the absorbed-field misparse this fixture was measured on — the absorb and the `def`-named-field split are the same ambiguity — so: (1) the previously swallowed real field `distance` now has a symbol (the fixture's own documented 'known residual, deliberately unpinned' is closed); (2) the constructor now parses as `constructor_declaration` and the analyzer emits kind `constructor` (java/kotlin family parity), still at its NAME's line 19 — the M59 (#825) contract that the name owns the line, not the field. The forbid entries keep the pre-fix shapes pinned so the misparse cannot silently return.
